name: Hercules Son of Zeus

features.name: Stacked Hercules
features.description: The hero is stacked on all reels and pays from two symbols.

features.name: Added wilds
features.description: Free spins add wilds to reels 2, 3 and 4 before every spin.

features.name: Extra spins
features.description: Each scatter during the bonus adds one free spin.

review:
One of Pragmatic's older games – a 4x5, 50-line grid where Hercules is stacked on every reel and pays from just two symbols, so mid-sized wins across several lines come fairly often.

Three Zeus symbols give free spins, where wilds are added to reels 2, 3 and 4 before each spin and every scatter adds a spin. Note the RTP is a noticeably lower 95.19%. Mostly interesting if you like older, line-heavy designs.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
